COLLECTION.NAME: ITPurchaseGST
COLLECTION.METHOD: ITKIND:if $$IsPurchase:$VoucherTypeName then "inv" else if $$IsDebitNote:$VoucherTypeName then "dn" else if $$IsCreditNote:$VoucherTypeName then "cn" else if $$IsJournal:$VoucherTypeName then "jv" else "pay"

TDLMESSAGE.SYSTEM: ($$IsPurchase:$VoucherTypeName OR $$IsDebitNote:$VoucherTypeName OR $$IsCreditNote:$VoucherTypeName OR $$IsJournal:$VoucherTypeName OR $$IsPayment:$VoucherTypeName) AND NOT $IsCancelled AND NOT $IsOptional
